public_body: Whittier Regional Vocational Technical School Committee
overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: a "budget work session" notice for the full budget was sufficiently specific, and notice of possible votes was not required.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the March 13, 2024 budget work session notice did not give adequate topic notice of the budget items the committee would consider.
allegations.key_passage: After review, we are satisfied that the Committee anticipated reviewing—and did review—the full budget; although it considered and voted on modifications to a few items the discussion focused on the budget as a whole.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the notice failed to tell the public that the committee would consider and vote on budget motions.
allegations.key_passage: the Open Meeting Law does not require that the notice separately indicate the possibility of a vote.
